text:
Lina: Quick thread: pilots asking for per-route burst capacity with easy on/off. Should this be an addon or change to mid-tier?

Devon: Ops: addon preferred if we can enforce quotas; tier if customers require stronger SLA.

Akash: Infra impact: needs scheduler hint + accounting for KV cache. Estimate 4 dev-days + perf.

Maya: Sales: customers want transparent pricing and a rollback credit if bursts harm latency. Also want UI toggle.

LegalBot: Need clear definition of "burst" window, misuse policy, and liability cap.

billing-bot: Billing shape suggestion: monthly hold $150 + per-token burst price. Example invoice line included.

Lina: Decision: prototype as metered addon with a small monthly hold. Run spike test and draft contract language. Owners: Akash (spike), Devon (impl), Maya (pilot). RFC due: 1758100000.

Devon: I'll add a single-click disable in console to allow immediate rollback.

Akash: Starting perf sim Monday. Tag me with traces.

Maya: I'll recruit two pilot customers for low-touch rollout.

LegalBot: Draft clause queued for review.

billing-bot: Billing ticket BILL-4921 created.

Lina: Great, keep UI minimal and pricing explicit.
